steps.text: Freeplay, V-Slice style! UP/DOWN pick a song, LEFT/RIGHT the difficulty, and ENTER plays it.
The songs of the character you're playing as. TAB opens Character Select to change it.
Q/E go through the letters to show only the songs that start with them, or your favorites. F makes the selected song a favorite.
Your best score and how much of the song you cleared.
And CTRL opens the gameplay changers. Have fun!
